question: Which two state governments held official-level talks in Guwahati in April 2025 to resolve the long-standing inter-state border dispute?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram and Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The inter-state border disputes between Mizoram and Assam have been ongoing for decades, primarily due to differing interpretations of boundary demarcations as outlined in colonial-era agreements.
 
• The governments of Mizoram and Assam held official talks in Guwahati in April 2025 to resolve this long-standing issue through peaceful dialogue and mutual understanding.
 
• The discussions were held at the official level to address contentious points along the 164.6 km shared border and find amicable solutions to prevent further conflicts.
 
• In recent years, tensions have occasionally escalated, leading to violent clashes along the border. These talks signify a positive step toward fostering peace and cooperation.
 
• Both states have committed to continuing such dialogues and maintaining the status quo at disputed locations to avoid further confrontations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inter-State Border Disputes in India**

 
 
• The central government frequently intervenes to mediate and resolve such disputes, emphasizing dialogue and peace-building efforts.
 
• Key border disputes include Assam-Meghalaya, Assam-Nagaland, and Assam-Mizoram, with Assam at the center of several conflicts due to its shared borders with multiple states.
 
• India has several inter-state border disputes, often arising from historical agreements, differences in interpretation of maps, or ethnic and cultural differences.
